1 info General Provisions

WazzimaGiygg is a digital ecosystem composed of collaborative platforms that offer free knowledge, communication, and publishing services, including, but not limited to:

  • WikiWorld: Collaborative encyclopedia
  • WazzimaGiygg Journal: Independent news portal
  • Bemtevi: Collaborative social network
  • Maspia Forum: Discussion forum
  • WikiZero: Free knowledge platform
  • WazzimaGiygg Academic: Academic and scientific platform
  • WazzimaGiygg Blog: Personal blogging platform
  • UWG Books: Digital library
  • User Center: Account management
  • Tickets: Customer support center
  • Spot (SkyHTML): Shared components and resources

📌 By accessing or using any of WazzimaGiygg's services, the user declares to have read, understood and fully accepted these Terms of Service, as well as the Privacy Policy (LGPD) available at wazzimagiygg.com/LGPD.

2 star Objective and Values

WazzimaGiygg's mission is to make free, accessible, and collaborative knowledge available to everyone, inspired by the principles of the Wikimedia Foundation, but with its own independent governance.

Fundamental Values:

  • ✅ Completely free services
  • ✅ Open and participatory collaboration
  • ✅ Responsible freedom of expression
  • ✅ Privacy and protection of personal data
  • ✅ Complete transparency in operations
  • ✅ Neutrality and impartiality
  • ✅ Combating harassment and persecution

3 person_add Registration and User Account

3.1. Account Creation

To use certain services, the user may create an account through:

  • Google Login (via Firebase Authentication)
  • Guest Access (limited, without data persistence)

3.2. Data Provided

When creating an account, the user provides:

  • Username (display name)
  • Email address (via Google)
  • Profile picture (optional, via Google)
  • Authentication data (managed by Firebase)

3.3. User Obligations

  • Provide true, accurate and up-to-date information
  • Maintain the confidentiality of your password and access data
  • Immediately notify WazzimaGiygg of any unauthorized use of your account
  • Be over 16 years of age or be duly authorized by a legal guardian
  • Do not share your account with third parties
  • Be responsible for all activities performed on your account

  • Ensure platform security

The user has the right to:

  • ✅ Request the anonymization, blocking or deletion of unnecessary data

  • ✅ Request data portability
  • ✅ Be informed about sharing with public or private entities

5.5. Data Security

6 gavel Marco Civil da Internet

WazzimaGiygg respects and follows the principles established by Law 12.965/2014.

6.1. Inviolability of Privacy (Art. 7, II and III)

Users' private communications are inviolable, except by court order. We do not disclose or share the content of private communications without express authorization.

6.2. Network Neutrality (Art. 9)

We respect network neutrality, treating all traffic equally, without discrimination based on content, origin, destination, or service.

6.3. No Undue Suspension (Art. 7, IX)

The connection and services may only be suspended or terminated for just cause, with prior notice and the right to a defense.

6.4. Responsibility for Third-Party Content (Art. 19)

WazzimaGiygg is not responsible for content published by users, but acts promptly to remove materials that violate the law or these Terms.

6.5. Storage and Protection of Records (Art. 10)

Access logs and browsing data are kept in a secure and controlled environment, and are only made available by court order or with the user's consent.

7 cookie Cookie Policy

WazzimaGiygg uses cookies and similar technologies to improve the browsing experience.

7.1. What are cookies?

Cookies are small text files stored on the user's device to identify preferences, analyze traffic, and personalize content.

🔒 WazzimaGiygg does not share personal data with advertisers. Ads are displayed based on anonymous data and cookies.

9 edit User-Generated Content

9.1. User Rights

The user retains all copyright to the content they publish on WazzimaGiygg's platforms.

9.2. License for Use

By publishing content, the user grants WazzimaGiygg a worldwide, non-exclusive, and royalty-free license to:

  • Host, store, display, and distribute the content
  • Allow other users to access and interact with the content
  • Perform backups and maintenance
  • Adapt the content for different formats and platforms

9.3. Prohibited Content

It is expressly forbidden to publish:

  • ❌ Illegal, defamatory, libelous or injurious content
  • ❌ Discriminatory material or material that incites hatred
  • ❌ Violations of copyright or intellectual property
  • ❌ Spam, malware or malicious links
  • ❌ Personal data of third parties without authorization (doxxing)
  • ❌ Pornographic content or explicit sexual nature
  • ❌ Deliberate misinformation (fake news)
  • ❌ Harassment, stalking or intimidation

9.4. Content Sanitization

All content submitted by users undergoes sanitization via DOMPurify to prevent XSS (Cross-Site Scripting) attacks.

10 block Prohibited Conduct

10.1. Violations Against Users

  • ❌ Stalking or harassing other users
  • ❌ Disclosing personal information of third parties without consent (doxxing)
  • ❌ Creating fake accounts or impersonating another person
  • ❌ Harassing, intimidating, or threatening other users

10.2. Technical Violations

  • ❌ Using automated tools or scripts for scraping or data collection
  • ❌ Attempting to access restricted areas or other users' data
  • ❌ Injecting malicious code or attempting to compromise security
  • ❌ Overloading servers with excessive requests

10.3. Legal Violations

  • ❌ Violating any provision of the LGPD or Marco Civil da Internet
  • ❌ Committing slander, defamation, or libel (Articles 138, 139, 140 of the Penal Code)
  • ❌ Committing malicious denunciation (Article 339 of the Penal Code)
  • ❌ Committing device intrusion (Article 154-A of the Penal Code)

11.3. User Guarantees

A banned user has the right to:

  • ✅ Prior communication about the applied sanction
  • ✅ Clear and detailed justification for the ban
  • ✅ Reasonable timeframe for presenting a defense (30 days)
  • ✅ Review of the decision by administrators not involved in the case
  • ✅ Right to appeal to the Arbitration Council

11.4. Appeals

The user may appeal the ban through the channel: support.wazzimagiygg.com

12 admin_panel_settings Role of Administrators and Moderators

12.1. Responsibilities

12.2. Prohibitions for Administrators

13.2. Subsidiary Liability

Under Article 19 of the Marco Civil da Internet, WazzimaGiygg may be held subsidiarily liable only if, after judicial notification and with a specific order, it fails to take steps to remove illegal content.

21 group Specific Rules for Social Networks

Applicable to Bem Te Vi and related platforms of the WazzimaGiygg ecosystem.

WazzimaGiygg offers the social network Bem Te Vi and other interactive platforms (such as the Maspia Forum). These networks are collaborative spaces that require ethical conduct and respect for the community. The rules below complement the General Terms and are mandatory.

21.1. Definition and Purpose

Bem Te Vi is a collaborative social network inspired by microblogging platforms, focusing on:

  • 🐦 Sharing ideas and knowledge
  • 🤝 Constructive community interaction
  • 🔒 Privacy and protection of user data
  • 🗣️ Responsible freedom of expression

21.2. Content and Publications

21.2.1. Allowed Content

It is allowed to publish:

  • ✅ Opinions and ideas, as long as they are respectful
  • ✅ Informative and educational content
  • ✅ Constructive debates on diverse topics
  • ✅ Sharing of knowledge and experiences

21.2.2. Prohibited Content (in addition to what is already foreseen in Article 9)

On social media, it is expressly prohibited:

  • ❌ Hate speech: Any content that promotes discrimination, prejudice, or violence against groups or individuals based on race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, or any other characteristic.
  • ❌ Harassment and intimidation: Stalking, threats, defamation, or any form of harassment directed at other users.
  • ❌ Mass disinformation (Fake News): Deliberate sharing of false information that may cause harm to society, public health or the integrity of democratic processes.
  • ❌ Spam and excessive self-promotion: Repetitive publication of commercial content, links to external websites without context, or attempts to manipulate engagement.
  • ❌ Violent or graphic content: Images, videos, or descriptions of explicit violence, cruelty, or illegal acts.
  • ❌ Adult content: Pornographic, sexually explicit material, or material that promotes nudity with sexual connotations.
  • ❌ Doxxing: Publication of personal information (address, phone number, documents, financial data) of third parties without explicit consent.
  • ❌ Impersonation: Creating fake profiles or impersonating another person, organization, or entity.

21.3. User Interactions

21.3.1. Good Interaction Practices

Users are expected to:

  • 🤝 Treat others with respect and courtesy
  • 🧠 Contribute to a healthy and productive environment
  • 📢 Report abusive behavior through official channels
  • 🛡️ Respect moderation decisions and the Terms of Service

21.3.2. Prohibited Interaction Practices

  • ❌ Stalking: Obsessive monitoring of other users' activity outside of normal platform interactions, especially with the intention of harassing or intimidating.
  • ❌ Brigading: Coordinating with other users to attack, silence, or promote smear campaigns against an individual or group.
  • ❌ Algorithm Manipulation: Attempts to deceive the platform's systems to artificially gain visibility or engagement.
  • ❌ Creating Multiple Accounts (Sockpuppetry): Creating secondary accounts to avoid sanctions, manipulate votes, or create a false impression of support or opposition.
  • ❌ Sharing Privileged Information: Disclosing internal information from the platform's administration, or regarding moderation, obtained improperly.

21.4. Moderation and Administration

21.4.1. Moderation Criteria

The moderation team (administrators and moderators) will act based on the following principles:

  • Impartiality: Decisions will be made based on the Terms and evidence, without personal bias.
  • Proportionality: Sanctions will be proportional to the severity of the infraction.
  • Transparency: The reasons for the decisions will be clearly communicated to the affected user.
  • Presumption of Innocence: The user will be considered innocent until proven otherwise, with the right to a defense.

21.4.2. Moderation Tools

Moderators may use the following tools to maintain order:

  • Content Removal: Deletion of posts, comments, or media that violate the rules.
  • Warning: Formal communication to the user about the infraction.
  • Temporary Suspension: Partial or total blocking of the account for a determined period (7, 15, or 30 days).
  • Permanent Ban: Permanent termination of the account, with the possibility of appeal.
  • Functionality Restriction: Temporary limitation of certain actions (e.g., posting, commenting, following).

21.5. Privacy and User Data

21.5.1. Public Data vs. Private

  • Profile information (username, bio, photo) is considered public by default.
  • Private messages, follower lists, and location data (when applicable) are considered private and will be protected in accordance with the LGPD.
  • Interaction data (likes, shares, replies) is public and can be viewed by the community, except when the user sets their account to private.

21.5.2. Additional Rights (in addition to Article 5.4)

  • Users have the right to export their data (published content, follower list, etc.) in a readable format.
  • Users may request the removal of their content (within operational and backup limits) when they close their account.
  • Users have the right to appeal moderation decisions, as per Article 18.

21.6. Content Licensing (Bem Te Vi)

The content published on the social network Bem Te Vi follows the Apache License 2.0, as specified in the official repository.

21.6.1. Consequences for Users

  • By publishing content on the platform, the user grants WazzimaGiygg and the community a worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free, and perpetual license to reproduce, distribute, display, and create derivative works of their content, under the terms of the Apache License 2.0.
  • The user retains the intellectual property of their content, but allows its use and adaptation by the community, provided that attribution is maintained.
  • The source code of the platform (HTML/CSS/JS) is also made available under the Apache License 2.0, encouraging open collaboration.

21.6.2. Exceptions

  • Content explicitly marked as "All rights reserved" by the user is not subject to this license.
  • Private conversations and direct messages are not covered by this license.

21.7. Interoperability and Third-Party Services

  • Bem Te Vi may offer integration with third-party services (e.g., sharing on other networks, social login).
  • Use of these integrations is subject to the terms and conditions of the respective services.
  • WazzimaGiygg is not responsible for third-party privacy practices.

21.8. Updates and Changes to the Platform

  • WazzimaGiygg may update the features, interface, and policies of the social network at any time.
  • Significant changes will be communicated with reasonable advance notice, through announcements on the platform or direct communication.
  • Continued use of the platform after such changes constitutes acceptance of the new conditions.

22 newspaper Specific Rules for the WazzimaGiygg Journal

Applicable to the independent news portal of the WazzimaGiygg ecosystem.

The WazzimaGiygg Journal is an independent news portal that offers quality journalistic content, with in-depth analysis, exclusive reports, and comprehensive coverage of politics, economics, international affairs, justice, culture, and investigations. The rules below complement the General Terms and are specific to the use and participation in the Journal.

22.1. Definition and Purpose

The WazzimaGiygg Journal is a platform for independent and collaborative journalism, with the following purposes:

  • 📰 Provide accurate, verified, and quality news
  • 🔍 Conduct in-depth investigations on relevant topics
  • 🗣️ Offer a space for well-founded analysis and opinions
  • 🌍 Cover local (Santa Fe do Sul) and global events
  • 📊 Promote transparency and the right to information

22.2. Content Licensing

22.2.1. Apache License 2.0

The source code of the WazzimaGiygg Journal is made available under the Apache License 2.0, as specified in the official repository.

22.2.2. Consequences for Contributors

  • By contributing articles, reports, or any content to the Journal, the contributor grants WazzimaGiygg and the community a worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free, and perpetual license to reproduce, distribute, display, and create derivative works of their content, under the terms of the Apache License 2.0.
  • The contributor retains the intellectual property of their content, but allows its use and adaptation by the community, provided that attribution is maintained.
  • The source code of the platform (HTML/CSS/JS) is also made available under the Apache License 2.0, encouraging open collaboration and joint development.

22.2.3. Exceptions

  • Content explicitly marked as "All rights reserved" by the contributor is not subject to this license.
  • Interviews and content from external sources may have their own licensing, which will be respected.

22.3. Editorial Standards and Quality

22.3.1. Commitment to Truth

The WazzimaGiygg Journal is committed to:

  • ✅ Factual accuracy: Fact-checking before publication
  • ✅ Impartiality: Balanced presentation of different perspectives
  • ✅ Transparency: Disclosure of sources and methodologies (when applicable)
  • ✅ Correction: Prompt retraction and correction of identified errors

22.3.2. Guidelines for Contributors

Contributors who wish to publish content in the Journal must follow:

  • 📌 Clear identification: Opinion articles must be identified as such
  • 📌 Citation of sources: Reference sources whenever possible
  • 📌 Respect for privacy: Do not disclose personal information without consent
  • 📌 Responsibility: Take responsibility for the published content

22.4. Prohibited Content in the Journal

In addition to what is already foreseen in Article 9, in the WazzimaGiygg Journal it is expressly prohibited to publish:

  • ❌ Fake News: Knowingly false information or intended to deceive
  • ❌ Sensationalist content: Headlines or articles that distort facts to generate unnecessary alarm or fear
  • ❌ Plagiarism: Copying content from other sources without proper attribution
  • ❌ Misleading advertising: Sponsored content not identified as such
  • ❌ Defamatory content: Unfounded accusations against people or organizations
  • ❌ Incitement to violence: Content that promotes illegal or violent acts

22.5. Comments and Reader Interaction

The WazzimaGiygg Journal may allow comments and interactions from readers. In these spaces, additional rules apply:

22.5.1. Allowed Comments

  • ✅ Respectful debates on the topics covered
  • ✅ Questions and requests for clarification
  • ✅ Informative complements with reliable sources

22.5.2. Prohibited Comments

  • ❌ Offensive comments: Insults, swearing, or aggressive language
  • ❌ Spam: Unsolicited advertising or irrelevant links
  • ❌ Misinformation: Sharing false information in the comments
  • ❌ Personal attacks: Offenses directed at journalists, sources, or other readers
  • ❌ Hate speech: Any form of prejudice or discrimination

22.6. Correction and Retraction Process

22.6.1. Right of Reply

Any person mentioned in an article has the right of reply, which will be published within a maximum period of 7 (seven) business days after the formal request.

22.6.2. Error Correction

  • Identified factual errors will be corrected with the appropriate clarification note
  • The correction will be highlighted at the beginning of the original article
  • Readers can report errors through the contact channel

22.6.3. Retraction

In cases of incorrect information that has caused harm to third parties, the Journal will publish a formal retraction with the same visibility as the original article.

22.7. Sources and Interviewees

22.7.1. Source Protection

The WazzimaGiygg Journal respects source confidentiality, guaranteeing anonymity when requested, under the terms of applicable legislation and the Journalists' Code of Ethics.

22.7.2. Use of Information from Sources

  • Information obtained from sources must be verified whenever possible
  • Anonymous sources will only be used in cases of relevant public interest
  • The identity of anonymous sources will be protected, except by court order

22.7.3. Interviewees

  • Interviewees have the right to review their quotes before publication (when previously agreed)
  • Interviews will be presented faithfully, without distortion of the meaning of the answers

22.8. Archive and Content Preservation

22.8.1. Permanent Archive

Articles published in the WazzimaGiygg Journal are preserved in a permanent archive, accessible through the "Archive" (archive.html) section of the site.

22.8.2. Robots.txt and Indexing

The Journal uses a robots.txt file to manage web crawler access, ensuring that:

  • Relevant content is properly indexed
  • Restricted areas (if any) are not crawled

22.8.3. Sitemap

The Journal maintains sitemap.xml and sitemap-jornal.xml to facilitate proper indexing of content by search engines.

22.9. Site Map and Navigation

The WazzimaGiygg Journal organizes its content into categories to facilitate navigation:

  • 🌐 WikiWorld: Encyclopedic and collaborative content
  • 📚 News: Daily journalistic coverage
  • 🎓 Academic: Scientific and academic content
  • 📖 Articles: Special reports and in-depth analysis
  • 📘 UWG Books: Reviews and literary content

Readers can navigate through these sections via the site's main menu.

22.10. Editorial Responsibility

22.10.1. Disclaimer of Liability

The WazzimaGiygg Journal is not responsible for:

  • Opinions expressed in signed articles, which are the sole responsibility of the author
  • Comments posted by readers
  • Content from external websites linked in the articles

22.10.2. Contributor Responsibility

The contributor is responsible for:

  • Ensuring the accuracy of the information in their content
  • Respecting third-party copyrights
  • Clearly identifying opinion content
  • Answering for any damages caused by false information published under their authorship

23 apps Rules for Complementary Services

Applicable to MASPIA Forum, Academic, User Center, Tickets and Spot.

The WazzimaGiygg ecosystem has several complementary services that integrate the user experience. The rules below apply specifically to each of them, complementing the General Terms.

23.1. MASPIA Forum

MASPIA is the forum platform of the WazzimaGiygg ecosystem, a space for discussions, knowledge sharing, and community interaction.

23.1.1. Definition and Purpose

  • 💬 Discussion forum organized by categories and topics
  • 🤝 Space to ask questions and share knowledge
  • 🏅 Reputation and community recognition system
  • 🔍 Permanent archive of relevant discussions

23.1.2. Licensing

The MASPIA source code is made available under the Apache License 2.0, as specified in the official repository.

23.1.3. Specific Forum Rules

  • ✅ Topics must be created in the appropriate category
  • ✅ Respect the hierarchy of topics and subcategories
  • ✅ Search for existing topics before creating new ones (avoid duplication)
  • ❌ Prohibited to "revive" old topics without relevant content (necroposting)
